panels.title: Recorded calls
panels.description: Metric-instrumented calls in selected event-time window. Legacy count batches are excluded; not a total of every historical call.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(calls) AS calls FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'outcomes'

panels.title: Non-success
panels.description: Includes nonzero exits, errors, timeouts, cancellations and unknown outcomes. A nonzero exit is not necessarily a product defect.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket IN ('nonzero','error','timeout','cancelled','unknown')) AS outcomes FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'outcomes'

panels.title: Calls ≥10 seconds
panels.description: Recorded duration bucket, not an inferred p95 or execution-time percentile.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'gte10000') AS slow_calls FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'durations'

panels.title: Data receipt
panels.description: Latest received telemetry at or before the window end. Receipt is not end-to-end delivery or instrumentation proof.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (extract(epoch FROM max(received_at))*1000)::bigint AS last_receipt FROM dashboard_events WHERE received_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz

options.content:
### What needs attention?
Start with **Tools to review**, ordered by recorded non-success count, then slow calls. Percentages apply **only to metric-recorded calls**. Nonzero exits may be expected; inspect the workload before diagnosing a defect. **Data receipt** means arrival, not complete coverage. Legacy counts are **not added**; missing metric rows mean *unknown*, not zero. Open **Data and delivery details** for coverage and audit context.

panels.title: Tools to review
panels.description: Metric stream only. Non-success includes nonzero, errors, timeout, cancelled and unknown; slow is ≥10 seconds. Independent outcome/duration marginals aggregated before joining by tool. A missing axis is unknown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH outcomes AS (
 SELECT tool,sum(calls) AS recorded_calls,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket IN ('nonzero','error','timeout','cancelled','unknown')) AS non_success,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'timeout') AS timeouts,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'error') AS errors,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'nonzero') AS nonzero_exits,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'unknown') AS unknown_outcomes
 FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'outcomes' GROUP BY tool
), durations AS (
 SELECT tool,sum(calls) AS duration_recorded_calls,
 sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'gte10000') AS slow_calls
 FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'durations' GROUP BY tool
)
SELECT coalesce(o.tool,d.tool) AS tool, o.recorded_calls,
 coalesce(o.non_success,0) AS non_success,
 round(100.0*coalesce(o.non_success,0)/NULLIF(o.recorded_calls,0),1) AS non_success_pct,
 coalesce(o.timeouts,0) AS timeouts,
 d.slow_calls AS slow_calls,
 round(100.0*d.slow_calls/NULLIF(d.duration_recorded_calls,0),1) AS slow_pct
FROM outcomes o FULL OUTER JOIN durations d ON o.tool=d.tool
ORDER BY non_success DESC NULLS LAST, slow_calls DESC NULLS LAST, tool

panels.title: Recorded outcomes by tool
panels.description: Distinct outcomes; a nonzero exit alone does not establish a defect.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'success') AS success, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'nonzero') AS nonzero, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'error') AS errors, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'timeout') AS timeouts, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'cancelled') AS cancelled, sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 'unknown') AS unknown FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'outcomes' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY tool

panels.title: Recorded calls by tool
panels.description: One metric stream only. Legacy counts are separately available below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tool, sum(calls) AS calls FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) AND axis = 'outcomes' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC
SELECT origin, event, count(*) AS delivered_events FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, event
SELECT origin, stream, tool, sum(calls) AS delivered_calls FROM dashboard_tools WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, stream, tool
SELECT origin, version_bucket, os_bucket, count(*) AS delivered_events FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, version_bucket, os_bucket

panels.title: Arrival lag p95 seconds (receipt-bearing events only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT origin, date_trunc('day', received_at) AS received_day, count(*) AS received_events, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (received_at-event_at))) AS p95_lag_seconds FROM dashboard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND event_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY origin, received_day
SELECT origin, tool, axis, bucket, sum(calls) AS calls FROM dashboard_metric_axes WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at) GROUP BY origin, tool, axis, bucket

panels.title: Timestamp quality (all history, including excluded events)

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time_quality, receipt_time_quality, count(*) AS records FROM dashboard_events GROUP BY event_time_quality, receipt_time_quality

panels.title: Recorded outcomes by tool — metrics stream only (selected UTC event window)

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.origin, a.tool, sum(a.calls) AS recorded_calls, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket IN ('nonzero','error','timeout','cancelled','unknown')),0) AS recorded_not_success, round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket IN ('nonzero','error','timeout','cancelled','unknown')),0) / NULLIF(sum(a.calls), 0), 1) AS not_success_pct, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'nonzero'),0) AS nonzero, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'error'),0) AS errors, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'timeout'),0) AS timeouts, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'cancelled'),0) AS cancelled, coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'unknown'),0) AS unknown_outcomes FROM dashboard_metric_axes a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.event_at) AND a.axis = 'outcomes' GROUP BY a.origin,a.tool ORDER BY recorded_not_success DESC NULLS LAST,a.tool

panels.title: Recorded duration buckets by tool — no latency percentile inferred

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.origin,a.tool,sum(a.calls) AS recorded_calls,coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'gte10000'),0) AS at_least_10_seconds,round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'gte10000'),0) / NULLIF(sum(a.calls),0),1) AS at_least_10_seconds_pct,coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'lt100'),0) AS under_100_ms,coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'lt1000'),0) AS under_1_second,coalesce(sum(a.calls) FILTER (WHERE a.bucket = 'lt10000'),0) AS under_10_seconds FROM dashboard_metric_axes a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.event_at) AND a.axis = 'durations' GROUP BY a.origin,a.tool ORDER BY at_least_10_seconds DESC,a.tool

panels.title: Instrumentation coverage by version and origin — batches, not unique calls

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.origin,e.version_bucket,count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'tool_counts') AS legacy_count_batches,count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'tool_metrics') AS metric_batches,CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'tool_metrics') > 0 THEN 'Metrics observed; coverage of all tools unknown' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'tool_counts') > 0 THEN 'Legacy counts only; outcomes/durations uninstrumented' ELSE 'Unknown: no tool batches' END AS evidence FROM dashboard_events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_at) AND e.event IN ('tool_counts','tool_metrics') GROUP BY e.origin,e.version_bucket ORDER BY e.origin,e.version_bucket
